Peaked wooden chalets and warm string lights line the passage, with a Christmas tree in a widened chamber. This is a seasonal artistic interpretation of a December 2026 evening in Europe/Amsterdam. It is not a December 2026 forecast. The Open-Meteo row is generation-time model data and is not the air in the cave. Valkenburg Castle remains NL-01-050 and is not in this frame. The Fluweelengrot chapel is not this gallery. No stall name is readable. No face is readable, and no person is the subject.
